Questions 147-149 refer to the following notice.

City of Hollisford Department of Sanitation
Curbside Food Scrap Collection Begins in April

Beginning on April 6, the City of Hollisford will add weekly food scrap
collection to its regular curbside service. [1] Each household will
receive a green 12-gallon container and a small kitchen pail by the end
of March. Residents should place fruit and vegetable peels, coffee
grounds, eggshells, and leftover food in the green container and set it
out on their usual recycling day. [2]

The collected material will be taken to the county composting facility
on Route 9, where it will be turned into soil for city parks and public
gardens. [3] Plastic bags, including those labeled as biodegradable,
should not be placed in the container.

Households that do not receive a container by March 31 should call the
Department of Sanitation at 555-0142. [4]

홀리스퍼드시 위생국

To introduce a new waste collection service

questions.q:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
"Residents may also pick up this finished soil for their own gardens at no cost."
questions.explain:

정답 (C) [3]
해석: [1], [2], [3], [4]로 표시된 위치 중 다음 문장이 들어가기에 가장 알맞은 곳은? "주민들도 이렇게 완성된 흙을 무료로 가져가 자기 정원에 쓸 수 있다."

Questions 173-176 refer to the following article.

Corlena Tile Expands Production in Hadley

HADLEY (August 3) — Corlena Tile, a maker of ceramic floor and wall
tiles, announced on Monday that it will open a second factory in the
Hadley Industrial Park. The new plant is expected to double the
company's production capacity and create about 150 jobs. [1]

Founded in 1994 as a small family workshop, Corlena now supplies tiles
to home improvement stores in eleven states. Demand for its glazed
tiles has grown steadily as more homeowners renovate kitchens and
bathrooms. [2] Last year, the company's sales rose by 18 percent.

The new factory will use kilns powered partly by solar panels installed
on the building's roof. [3] Chief executive Marta Lindqvist said the
company chose Hadley because of its skilled workforce and its location
near two major highways. [4] Hiring is scheduled to begin in January,
and the plant should be fully operational by next summer.

1994년 작은 가족 공방으로 시작한 코를레나는 현재 11개 주의 주택 개조 용품점에 타일을 공급한다. 부엌과 욕실을 개조하는 주택 소유자가 늘면서 유약 타일 수요가 꾸준히 증가해 왔다. 작년에 회사 매출은 18퍼센트 올랐다.

Questions 182-186 refer to the following notice and e-mail.

City of Ellesmere — Summer Internship Program

The City of Ellesmere is now accepting applications for its paid summer
internship program. Interns will work for ten weeks, from June 15 to
August 21, in one of the following departments:

- Finance: assist with budget reports and data entry
- Parks and Recreation: help coordinate youth sports and summer events
- Public Works: support engineers with road and water system surveys
- Communications: write content for the city's Web site and social media

Applicants must be at least 18 years old and currently enrolled in a
college or university. Interns earn $17 per hour and work 30 hours per
week. Public Works interns must hold a valid driver's license, as they
will travel to sites throughout the city.

To apply, submit a résumé, a one-page cover letter, and the name of one
academic reference through the city's job portal by March 20. Selected
candidates will be invited to interview in April.

=====

To: Human Resources <hr@ellesmere.gov>
From: Jaylen Moreau <jmoreau@tarrantcollege.edu>
Date: March 12
Subject: Internship application

Dear Human Resources staff,

I submitted my application for the summer internship program through
the job portal yesterday. I am a third-year civil engineering student at
Tarrant College, and I am especially interested in working with your
engineers on the city's water system surveys.

I should mention that I am currently taking driving lessons and expect
to receive my license in early May. I would like to know whether this
would affect my eligibility. I am also happy to provide a writing sample
if that would strengthen my application.

Thank you for your time.

Sincerely,
Jaylen Moreau

To schedule an interview

questions.q: In the notice, the word "accepting" in paragraph 1, line 1, is closest in meaning to
options: agreeing
receiving
believing
tolerating
questions.explain:

정답 (B) receiving
해석: 공지에서 1단락 1행의 단어 "accepting"과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

오답 분석: (A) agreeing: '동의하는'. accept a proposal(제안을 받아들이다) 쪽 뜻이다. / (C) believing: '믿는'. accept a story(말을 믿다) 쪽 뜻이다. / (D) tolerating: '참는, 용인하는'. 불편을 받아들일 때 뜻이다.

오답 분석: (A) enrolled in a college = enrollment in a school. 언급됐다. / (B) at least 18 = minimum age. 언급됐다. / (D) academic reference. 지원 서류로 언급됐다.
